items.text: While Strength exceeds Intelligence, Ability hits gran Stellar Flux which provides Attack Speed. Stacks decay every 3s.  Otherwise, Basic Attacks grant Astral Flux. Abilities consume this for bonus Magical Damage and effects.

Astral Flux: Consumes 4 stacks to cause targets to lose Protections.

Astral Flux: Consumes 4 stacks to cause the comet to echo, damaging and trembling again.
Teleport in the direction your are moving and fire homing projectiles at nearby enemies that deal Magical damage and applies a stacking slow.
Stellar Flux: Resets cooldown of Convergence and grants 8 ammo
Astral Flux: Consumes 4 stacks to fire 2 additional projectiles.
Become CC immune and ascend into the sky. Fire a massive black hole that deals Magical damage before detonating for additional damage and Pulling enemies toward the center.

Nut’s Convergence is now properly considered a single ability fire, regardless of the amount of ammo that you have. This means that subsequent shots will properly know if the previous shots had triggered an item effect and will respect once per ability or once per ability target rules.
Tl;dr: No more Heartseeker proc on every single shot, but also it will proc at 100% effectiveness when Heartseeker Procs
Qin’s Sais however occurs on each Attack hit effects fully.
Made Adjustments to how Nut’s Cached Ammo generation works.
Smite 1: While Convergence is active, once each convergence shot, store ammo. At the end, grant this ammo for the next usage of Convergence.
If you hit a minion, it would be 1 per shot. Even if you hit a God later.
If you hit a god, it would be 2 per shot
Smite 2 First Implementation: While Convergence is active once per target hit by each convergence shot, store ammo, At the end, grant this ammo for the next usage of Convergence
This means damaging a God and a minion, you would gain 3 ammo, and the next shot could generate 3 ammo as well.
Back to once per each fire.
If you hit a minion first however, it will attempt to grant you another cached ammo if that later hits a god.

content.text: KUKULKAN IS HEADING INTO THE JUNGLE!

On January 2, we’re releasing the Aspect of the Squall, a complete reimagining of Kukulkan’s kit. This Aspect is designed for players who want to get up close and personal, trading long-range poke for devastating "shotgun" burst and aggressive utility.
♻️ NEW PASSIVE: SOUL OF THE SQUALL
Master the Jungle to fuel your power. You now gain permanent Mana from:

items.text: Synergizes perfectly with Kukulkan's base passive to scale your late-game damage!

items.detail: The range is shorter, but the punch is massive. You now fire 3 projectiles in a spread—land all three at point-blank range for a true "shotgun" blast.
No longer just a speed boost. This ability is now always a dash that steals Protections from any enemy you pass through, making you harder to kill while you shred your target.

Forget ground targets. Your Whirlwind now attaches to YOU, following you as you move before exploding in a blast that knocks back all nearby enemies. Use it to engage or to peel for yourself mid-dive!
